description: This file contains Python code for generating and testing X.509 certificate policies, including functions to create policy qualifiers, policy information, and generate policy files with various configurations.

classes.name: CertificatePoliciesGenerator
classes.description: A class to generate certificate policies in ASN.1 format and output to files.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a certificate policy file with a specified token, ASN.1 structure, and output filename.

methods.name: add_policy
methods.description: Adds a policy to the CertificatePoliciesGenerator instance.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns the ASN.1 string representation of the current policies.
